reviews.title: SSD Compliant with Standard SATA
reviews.comment:
This SSD carry the same SATA specs as all SSD's that comply with SATA standards, so there isn't any non-bench test way to say whether this is better than another SSD.  Samsung is noted for quality memory products but about 50% more expensive than this SanDisk, WD, Crucial, etc. which are long time US brands.  SanDisk was an original producer of USB drives 20-years ago and then SSD drives, then acquired by Western Digital and spun off as independent company in 2025.
Thus, SSD is faster than spin HDD, but longevity is unknown, but it can't be any worse that the 7-9 years that I've experienced with WD and Seagate spin HDD's.  This replaced a spin HDD in an 2013 iMac (in 2025) and has given a new speed life despite an older Intel i5 4-Core CPU.  Mac OS10.15 Black Magic Utility rated Read/Write speeds of 400-500MB/s compared to 50-100Mb/s for OEM SEagate 1TB spin HDD.  If your PC has a PCIe bus, the NVMe "blade" SSD has much faster speed than SATA SSD, but I already had this SSD when I discovered the PCIe option.  Regardless, Storage Memory will fail (twice for me) and without backup like a cloud storage or onsite NAS, your files are at risk even if the failure is 7-9 years from now.
reviews.author: Sui Lin Chee
